notes.title: Update – New Zombie
notes.content:
Hi again everyone!
Thanks for all the support you've given to 2017 VR, and the many cool feedback suggestions we've received and are looking into.

We continually strive to improve the gameplay and create great new content in 2017 VR so that everybody is able to enjoy the best possible VR experience.

[h1]The main features of this new update:[/h1]
1. New Zombie
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27712948/a618359b9333ae9e17f731031bde19d6696b735c.png[/img]
Multiple genes mixed mutant zombies. It has strong limbs and has an extraordinary jump ability. Its hands and feet will secrete a special mucus, can make themselves attached to other objects.

2. New varieties of zombie dogs will meet you in the game.



[h1]Bug Fixes & Optimization [/h1]
(Thanks to all those who reported them and provided help.)

* Optimize the M2A1 machine gun: When using the M2A1 machine gun, you can move within a certain range near the machine gun. It is recommended to use teleport.

* Optimize zombie dogs: zombie dogs will skip the damaged windows into the room, reduce the zombie dog's health, increase the number of zombie dogs.

* Optimization operation: pick up the oil drum can be moved.

* Fixed a problem with some of the objects in the scene of the factory.

* Fix common zombie attacks.

* Reduce the damage caused by melee weapons to Boss.

* Adjust the zombie Boss health value. Zombie Boss will not be hurt when hugging his head.

* Optimize ammo box: use ammo box will get more ammo.

* [b]Increase the test version of the auxiliary ability: right hand left side of the Grip button + left hand right side of the Grip button = zombie scan[/b]

[h1]About 2017 VR - We value all feedback from all of our players, so please let us know what you think and what you would like to see in the future versions of the game.[/h1]

notes.title: 2017 VR - Officially Released
notes.content:
Today, "2017 VR" officially released, I am glad we can witness this moment together.

"2017 VR" on February 17, 2017 released the Early Access Game version. It has been more than two months to date. Your support for the 2017VR gives us a great deal of motivation, and your feedback makes the whole game perfect. Here we would like to thank the players who love 2017VR.

In the period before today's official release. We carefully list all the feedback for the game as a whole to do a planning. We finished two important things for the game.[list]
[*] We made a major optimization for the game. We used the 1070 to test, in the case of no particle effects, the game can be basically stable at 90 frame rate. At the same time exciting is that our optimization does not affect the picture quality.
[*] We added another important function for the game - melee weapons. In the early stages of the game we are still considering whether to add this function for the game. When the zombies are close to us we can do something. But we found that without too much consideration, because you also very much hope that in the game can pick up melee weapons and zombies fighting. Brave victory!
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27712948/8d01f95427d1ab0880ddb3d40da701db04772c0d.png[/img]
[/list]

Bug Fixes & Optimization 
(Thanks to all those who reported them and provided help.)[list]
[*] The highest level will be raised from the original 15 to 20.
[*] Optimize the factory floor to prevent the locomotion from being blocked.
[*] Fixed Arsonist skills, the flamethrower will have a higher fire damage.[/list]
After the official release. We focus on adding more content to the game. The main contents are zombies and weapons. May add new maps and other interesting little objects. At the same time will optimize the game encountered in a variety of problems, such as the use of machine guns sometimes hit the real wall and so on.

[h1]About 2017 VR - We value all feedback from all of our players, so please let us know what you think.[/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - Flamethrower & M2A1 Machine Gun
notes.content:
[h1]Hi again everyone![/h1]
Thanks for all the support you've given to 2017 VR, and the many cool feedback suggestions we've received and are looking into.

We continually strive to improve the gameplay and create great new content in 2017 VR so that everybody is able to enjoy the best possible VR experience.

[h1]The main features of this new update:[/h1]
1. Homemade Flamethrower: One of the essential weapons for survival come the end of the world as its fiery touch can immolate a horde of rampaging zombies at once. Get ready to burn these abominations with some cleansing fire and return the world to the living. Do you sometimes feel the urge to purify your companions with fire?

2. M2A1 Machine Gun: It is effective against infantry, unarmored or lightly armored vehicles, light fortifications and now come the end of the world, the undead. The M2 has been produced longer than any other machine gun in existence and fires out its huge .50 caliber shells at a rate of 450 rounds per minute up to 2,200 yards away. Its zombie killing time! 

3. Settings interface added to change the 'Locomotion Operation Type.' HTC players can choose from the mobile or touch mobile options.

4. Settings interface added to change the 'Teleport Direction Control.' All players can choose whether to open the function.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27712948/3e8e7aeeb50a582b804ea0a668c7e3fa1f740e24.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Optimization [/h1]
(Thanks to all those who reported them and provided help.)

[*] Fixed the problem where part of the game's item does not disappear when picked up by the player.

notes.title: Update - Locomotion & Team
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!
Thank you very much for supporting 2017 VR, and leaving us a lot of very cool suggestions.

This update takes us a long time to work on, but it worth. We strive to improve gameplay experiences and make great new contents, so that everybody in 2017VR can get a better experience. 

Followings are the main features of this update:
1.	Add the .44Magnum pistol to the supply boxes.
2.	Add M67 and MK2 grenades to the supply boxes.
3.	Add a list of rooms that you can choose the favorite room.
4.	Now you can create a room, choose to play with friends or the global players.
5.	Now you can invite your Steam friends to enter the game.
6.	Now you can move after death.

Bug Fixes & Optimization (Thanks to those who reported and provided help to us.)[list]
[*] Fixed zombies not getting through the door in the factory level sometimes.
[*] Fixed the problem that P90 gun cannot be bought in the subway level.
[*] Fixed the problem that teleporting is not functioning occasionally around the front door in the western saloon.
[*] Fixed grenades and guns overlap problem.
[*] Fixed the problem that the battle statistics are not shown completely in levels.
[*] Fixed a problem that no zombies are born in the abandon factory level.
[*] Optimize the scene rendering of all levels, switch on the rendering configuration won't affect a lot on the screen brightness any longer.
[*] Optimize the grenade explosion effect.
[*] Optimize the P90 and M4 aiming experiences.
[/list]

notes.title: Update – New Level
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!
Thank you very much for supporting 2017 VR.

We expect to add inviting friend function and trackpad locomotion on the next update that you may be looking forward to.

1.	New Level - Abandoned Factory: Not long ago we found this abandoned factory. After a simple cleaning, it finally became our new fortified point. But we found a large number of zombies around it, and unknown kind of zombies too. The good news is that we have not been attacked from the unknown zombies, but we will continue to strengthen the defense to prevent the arrival of unknown danger.
2.	Global Survivors Ranking: Heroes will always emerge from war, no exception for the end of the world. We need to remember these heroes’ contributions for us, thank them and worship them together. 
3.	Menu Function: Use the left-hand controller's menu key to open / close the interface during combat. The menu function includes leaving the room to return to the main scene as well as the trackpad locomotion switch.

Bug Fixes & optimize（ Thanks to everyone who reports and provides help to us. ）[list]
[*] Gun shooting accuracy issue optimization.
[*] Reduce zombie moaning frequency.
[*] Subway level decoration.
[*] Fix the game picture quality adjustment does not work.
[*] Gas canisters are more easier to explode after being attacked.
[/list]
Coming Soon：[list]
[*] Trackpad locomotion (30%).
[*] Invite friends function (40%).
[*] Microphone speech issue.
[*] Other content.

notes.title: Update - Oculus Touch Model & Start Game
notes.content:
Hi, everybody!
Thank you very much for supporting 2017 VR.

We have collected all the issues that have arisen and all the suggestions since the game has been released. We are gradually to modify the problems and to achieve the functions, while adding more game contents.

- 2017 VR may not be friendly to the Oculus players and we have decided to focus on repairing such problems by priority. We hope everyone can be comfortable playing the game. This update adds the Oculus Touch handle model, adjusts the guns angle for the oculus rift, and fixes other related issues.
- We found that there is still a lot of work to do about the multiplayer part of the game. In this update we release the optimized [multiplayer] entrance. Starting game from this entrance, it will lead you to find the existence and missing players survivors squad at the first place. Otherwise it will build your own team and waiting for other players to join it. So that we can start the game more quickly and find online teammates. In the subsequent updates, we will add the functions of the steam friends invited, create team, etc.

[h1]Bug Fixes & optimize（ Thanks to everyone who reports and provides help to us. ）[/h1]
[list]
[*] Subway level Catton issues optimization.
[*] Some issues about joining the game.
[*] Game probability collapse issues.
[*] Return button does not work the issues.
[*] Fix the issue of no resurrection at the subway level.
[/list]
